showOverlayColorMappingLegends.description:
Whenever to show legends for the overlay color mapping.

@see UiGeospatialAssetsMapOverlayMappingSpec

overlayColorMappingLegendTitle.description: Title to show for the overlay mapping legends group.

showMarkerIconLegends.description:
Whenever to show legends for the markers icons.

We use the {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapMarkerStyleSpec#iconField} to get which icon to display,
and #markersIconLegendField to know which label to set for that icon.

When enabled, this generates a list of "tuples" with unique
(#markersIconLegendField, {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapMarkerStyleSpec#iconField}) values from the data provided,
and displays the legend for each of them.

@see UiGeospatialAssetsMapMarkerStyleSpec

markersIconLegendTitle.description: Title to show for the icons legends group.

markersIconLegendField.description: Field to extract the label to display for the icon.

showMarkerBadgeLegends.description:
When enabled, the badges configured in {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapMarkerStyleSpec#badgesConfig} will be displayed.

If {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapBadgesSpec#icon} is defined, this icon will be used, otherwise only a `circle` will
be displayed. ({@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapBadgesSpec#displayField} is ignored)

@see UiGeospatialAssetsMapMarkerStyleSpec

markerBadgeLegendsTitle.description: Title to show for the badge legends group.

labelByPosition.description: When #showMarkerBadgeLegends is enabled, this will determine which label to apply to each badge configuration.

title:
Configuration on how to display the legends for the map.

Currently we only support legends for the asset icons, and overlay colors.
name: UiGeospatialAssetsMapLegendsSpec
